summary: FOXO Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Strategic Technology License Agreement with its founder and his affiliated LLC, LongevityFP Technologies. The agreement grants an exclusive worldwide license to commercialize FOXO's epigenetics IP, including patents and datasets, in exchange for a 3% royalty capped at $1.3M, and includes a ten-year option for the licensee to acquire majority ownership of FOXO's subsidiary via one of two tracks (100% or 60% equity). The company retains ownership of the IP. This is a licensing/strategic deal, not a special-situation transaction like an acquisition or spin-off. No price per share, premium, or typical M&A terms are present. The filing is a routine material agreement disclosure with no special-situations elements.
